# Reference dataset A

Chord shapes for the Greek bouzouki, tetrachordo (C F A D) and trichordo
(D A D), from a reference used with its owner's permission. By agreement the
source is not named. The files hold only chord names and frets, per course,
lowest first (-1 muted, 0 open).

`scripts/import-reference-bouzouki.ts` builds `data/bouzouki-cfad` and
`data/bouzouki-dad` from these files; voicings taken from them cite
`{ "type": "reference-dataset", "id": "ref-a" }`.

Never edit these files by hand.
